503:t_112:6.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「A future built on taking someone's life will only breed new hatred! Please, understand that!」

503:t_112:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「What...!? $$マリーダ$$'s words are echoing in my head!?」

503:t_112:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「The $$バンシィ$$ remembers my wavelength...!? Is that what's interfering with Ensign $$リディ$$!」

503:t_112:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「Stop it! Quit trying to get inside me!」

503:t_112:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「You space monsters! Destroying you is $$クロノ$$'s duty!」

503:t_113:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「You must have sniffed out that $$リリーナ・ピースクラフト$$ is here, $$ヒイロ$$!」

503:t_113:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$リリーナ$$ chose to live as a $$ドーリアン$$, not as a $$ピースクラフト$$.」

503:t_113:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「She is not bound by the house or the blood you speak of. She chose her own path by her own will, so calling her by the name $$ピースクラフト$$ is unforgivable.」

503:t_113:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Don't talk like you know me!」

503:t_113:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you are jealous, then live that way yourself. If you cannot, I will give up on you...!」

503:t_114:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「$n! I've learned your habits in the simulations!」

503:t_114:3.en:
$n
「I've changed, just like you have, Ensign! At least I've been fighting to become stronger!」

503:t_114:4.en:
$n
「I'll show you the result! It's my way of thanking you, Ensign, for training with me all this time!」

503:t_114:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Try it, if you can! Don't think a guy like you can overcome the despair I've known!!」

503:t_115:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$!! You, I'll deal with myself...!」

503:t_115:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Ensign $$リディ$$ is serious...! Is there no choice but to fight...!?)
